name: mcpserver-repl
description: Install or refresh the current SharpNinja.McpServer.Repl 6.1.1 .NET global tool distribution from the official McpServerTools bucket.
commandTemplate: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $version='6.1.1'; $pkg='SharpNinja.McpServer.Repl'; $dir=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mcpserver-repl-6.1.1'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null; $nupkg=Join-Path $dir 'SharpNinja.McpServer.Repl.6.1.1.nupkg'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sharpninja/McpServerTools/main/packages/SharpNinja.McpServer.Repl.6.1.1.nupkg' -OutFile $nupkg; $installed=dotnet tool list -g | Select-String -Quiet '^sharpninja\.mcpserver\.repl\s'; if($installed){ dotnet tool uninstall --global $pkg | Out-Null }; dotnet tool install --global $pkg --version $version --add-source $dir; mcpserver-repl --version"
